newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - CPFL started as reduce.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - CPFL started as reduce.

text.p: -- Robert Fleming Inc said it initiated coverage of Sao Paulo state-owned CPFL, known as Companhia Paulista de Forca e Luz, with a reduce recommendation.
-- "CPFL is a great opportunity for trade buyers but its stock market outperformance could stall in the next six months," Fleming said in a report titled "Put a Fork In It, It's Almost Done."
-- The brokerage also said CPFL's post-privatization upside potential is "less compelling than that of its peers Eletropaulo, Coelce and Cerj."
-- Moreover, it added, CPFL's low consumer density, enviable energy-loss ratio and limited downsizing potential "leave little room for meaningful operating margin expansion."
-- Shares of CPFL, Sao Paulo's second-largest electricity distributor, have soared 105.7 percent since the end of 1995, it said.
-- Fleming estimates the firm's 1996 net at $93.5 million, compared with a net loss of $51.6 million in 1995. It projects 1997 net at $137.9 million.
-- CPFL shares were untraded by 1133 local/1333 GMT on the Sao Paulo bourse. On Thursday its preferred closed at 72 reais while its common voting share ended at 98 reais.
